therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: therapeutic vaccination to induce CD8+ T cell responses against HPV16 E7 antigen
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: immune-mediated tumor cell killing through CD8+ T cell activation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: HLA-A*02 positive patients with incurable HPV16-related oropharyngeal, cervical and anal cancer
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: dose limiting toxicity, treatment-related adverse events, and CD8+ T cell response

results.effect_size: 16.7% CD8+ T cell responders in Phase Ib cohort with DPX-E7 + cyclophosphamide
results.target_engagement_evidence: CD8+ T cell responses measured by dextramer and ELISpot methods
biomarker_changes: 16.7% of patients in Phase Ib cohort showed ≥2-fold increase in CD8+ T cells
subgroup_findings: Phase Ib cohort showed better CD8+ T cell responses than Phase II cohorts
Combination with cyclophosphamide appeared more active than DPX-E7 alone
safety_signals: Serious adverse events included myocardial infarction, death, fever, respiratory infections
results.dose_information: DPX-E7 vaccine with or without cyclophosphamide

context.comparator: none (single arm study with different cohorts)
